svg.title: DSpark Attention Visibility
svg.desc: Each seven-query Draft block reads the context prefix before its anchor and its own full seven-token block. Other blocks and future context are masked.
svg.metadata: {"scope":"schematic visibility mask; not measured tensor dimensions or performance","source":"aspec/models/ops/cudnn_flex_attention.py::build_dspark_mla_mask","context_length":18,"block_size":7,"anchor_positions":[5,10],"query_rows":14,"key_columns":32,"visible_cells":203,"context_visibility":"position < anchor, within the current document","draft_visibility":"own entire block; bidirectional","initial_block_inputs":"anchor token followed by six MASK tokens"}
svg.text: Own context prefix + own Draft block · full attention · B = 7
Each block sees its own context prefix and all B draft positions. [MASK] inputs contain no future target tokens.
